latvia.title: Two 'Latvian nationals' arrested for entering airbase in England
latvia.description: Two men described as being Latvian were arrested on October 8th on suspicion of illegally entering a Royal Air Force (RAF) military base in Cambridgeshire, England which is used by the United States Air Force.

latvia.title: 'Two-basket' healthcare system postponed again in Latvia
latvia.description: The Saeima has postponed the introduction of the so-called ‘two healthcare service baskets’ principle for a further year – until 31 December next year – as decided by parliament on Thursday during the second and final reading under an urgent procedure. The introduction of this principle has been postponed for several years now, Latvian Radio reports.

latvia.title: Annual inflation in Latvia at 3.2% in September
latvia.description: Central Statistical Bureau data, published on 8 October, show that compared with September 2025, the average level of consumer prices rose by 3.2 % in September 2026.

latvia.description: On Friday, 9 October, strong winds are expected in Latvia, which may cause damage in some areas, according to the Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre (LVĢMC).

latvia.title: Russians, Belarusians banned from owning critical infrastructure in Latvia
latvia.description: Citizens of Russia and Belarus will not be able to acquire a significant stake or exert decisive influence in critical infrastructure facilities in Latvia, the Saeima decided on Thursday, 8 October, as reported by LSM.lv and LETA.

latvia.title: Latvian book exhibition opens at European Parliament
latvia.description: An exhibition dedicated to 500 years since the first book in Latvian was published was opened at the European Parliament (EP) building in Strasbourg this week. The exhibition was created in cooperation with the National Library of Latvia (LNB), reports Latvian Radio.

latvia.title: Theatre director Hermanis quits as leader of party he founded
latvia.description: The head of the New Riga Theatre, director Alvis Hermanis, has resigned from his duties as the leader of the "We Change the Rules" (MMN) party, he has announced on social media.

latvia.title: Former Latvian football captain set to head civil service
latvia.description: The post-playing careers of many former professional footballers often include punditry and coaching, but Latvia's former national football captain is in line to head the country's civil service.

latvia.title: 'Burnout alley' unveiled in Rīga
latvia.description: This week, special attention is being paid to mental health, as World Mental Health Day will be observed across the globe on Saturday. During Mental Health Week, a series of events is taking place at the National Centre for Mental Health, and an art walk dedicated to burnout was opened on Wednesday, Latvian Television reported on October 7.

latvia.title: Latvia's High Five charity drive to focus on mental health this year
latvia.description: Latvian Public Media (LSM)’s charity marathon “Dod pieci!/High Five!” will focus this year on mental health and suicide prevention in Latvian society, the organisers have announced.

latvia.title: Quarter of postal votes deemed invalid in Latvia
latvia.description: In the recent 15th Saeima elections, out of the 444 postal votes received by the Latvian Postal Voting Commission, 118 were deemed invalid, the Central Election Commission (CVK) told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Flu monitoring season begins in Latvia
latvia.description: The 2026–2027 monitoring season for influenza and other acute respiratory infections has begun in Latvia, but so far, Latvia has only received the intranasal ‘Fluenz’ vaccine, which is intended for children who belong to specific health risk groups, according to the Disease Prevention and Control Centre (SPKC). This season, the production of influenza vaccines in Europe has been delayed; consequently, vaccine deliveries to Latvia are taking place gradually and slightly later than usual this year. Deliveries of the ‘Efluelda’ flu vaccine to GP practices will begin this week. This vaccine is intended for people aged 60 and over, as well as those with moderate or severe immunosuppression. Meanwhile, the “Vaxigrip” vaccine, which is intended for other target groups eligible for state-funded vaccination – including adults and children with chronic illnesses – is expected to arrive in Latvia by 13 November. This season, state-funded flu vaccination will be provided using three vaccines, each intended for different population groups. The first laboratory-confirmed cases of flu in Latvia this season were recorded even before the start of the flu monitoring season and were linked to travel outside Latvia. Meanwhile, in week 40 of 2026, when monitoring began, influenza was clinically diagnosed in three patients, or 3.9 cases per 100,000 population, which is lower than during the corresponding period of the previous season (9.9 cases per 100,000 population). A total of 918 patients, or an average of 1,179.3 per 100,000 population, consulted their GPs with symptoms of other acute respiratory infections. The prevalence of other acute respiratory infections is also slightly lower than during the corresponding period of the previous season. Last week, influenza was not laboratory-confirmed in any of the 166 samples tested, whilst RSV infection was confirmed in one sample (0.6 per cent), according to laboratory surveillance data. The proportion of Covid-19-positive samples was 1.2 per cent, remaining at roughly the same level as the previous week. Unlike in previous years, no increase in Covid-19 cases was observed in late summer and early autumn this year.

latvia.title: First 'Hunter' military vehicle delivered to Latvian armed forces
latvia.description: The first "Hunter" (“Mednieks”) infantry fighting vehicle adapted for Latvia has been handed over to the National Armed Forces (NBS), it was announced on October 7th.

latvia.title: Latvians not particularly keen to get physical
latvia.description: Despite having a rather nice outdoors to explore, Latvians in general, including younger people, are not particularly outdoorsy or keen to get physically active, according to Eurostat data published on October 7th,

latvia.title: Indian cultural evening coming soon to groovy Rīga venue
latvia.description: October 17th will see a special evening of Indian and Latvian culture at the K. K. von Stricka Villa venue in Rīga.

latvia.title: Strong wind expected Friday in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that strong winds are expected in Latvia on Friday, which may cause minor damage in some areas.

latvia.title: Lidl Latvia boasts five-year figures
latvia.description: The retailer SIA ‘Lidl Latvija’ has invested more than 420 million euros in the company’s development over the past five years, the company announced on October 7.

latvia.title: How to say 'sorry' in Latvian
latvia.description: The always-enjoyable Irregular Latvian YouTube channel is back with another video, and this time's it's one that's very useful indeed: how to say 'sorry'.

latvia.title: Latvian film industry annoyed by Kulbergs' 'streaming tax' U-turn
latvia.description: The film and culture industry is expressing confusion over Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs' (United List) announcement that the government should consider abandoning the planned streaming platform, or so-called "Netflix tax", and instead focus more on supporting the development of the film industry.

latvia.title: Blood donors needed in Latvia
latvia.description: The National Blood Donor Centre (VADC) is calling on the public to continue to be supportive throughout October and to donate blood, so that together we can ensure a stable blood supply for Latvia’s hospitals.

latvia.title: Living as a senior in Latgale isn't easy
latvia.description: In Latgale, incomes are lower, residents are more likely to face health problems, and the number of young people and working-age residents is decreasing. This means that in the future, more and more people may need help in old age, but there will be fewer and fewer people who can provide this help.

latvia.title: New Unity faces some post-election soul searching
latvia.description: The New Unity political party (Jauna Vienotība/JV) is not satisfied with its results in the recent Saeima elections and plans to evaluate them at an extraordinary congress, party chair and former Prime Minister Evika Siliņa told LTV's 'Morning Panorama' show on October 7th.

latvia.title: 'Family health' subject proposed for Latvian schools; ideology concerns raised
latvia.description: The Ministry of Education and Science has begun a review of the general education curriculum; it is possible that a family health education module could also be included in the primary school curriculum. However, this proposal has caused concern amongst representatives of several healthcare and other sectoral associations, who have highlighted that the proposed ‘family health’ education contains very little health literacy, Latvian Radio reported on October 7.

latvia.title: App for drone detection being developed in Latvia
latvia.description: Kristaps Gertmanis, a resident of Cēsis Municipality, has spent several months of his free time developing the ‘AirAlert’ app. It is designed to collate information provided by people and various sensors and help us understand the situation in our airspace, Latvian Television reported on October 6,

latvia.title: NBS: Migrant group pushed aggressively across Latvian border this week
latvia.description: This week, masked, aggressive and armed escorts from Belarus attempted to smuggle a group of border crossers into Latvia, the National Armed Forces (NBS) said on October 6.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 6th October, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Operation Werewolf to run until end of year in Latvia
latvia.description: On Tuesday, 6 October, the government decided to extend Operation ‘Vilkatis’, which is being carried out on Latvia’s eastern border to combat illegal migration, until the end of this year – 31 December, according to the State Chancellery.

latvia.title: Slight summer rise in Latvia's industrial production
latvia.description: Central Statistical Bureau calendar adjusted data (at constant prices) published on October 6th show that in August 2026 industrial production output increased by 0.3 % year on year.

latvia.title: Fuel prices up nearly 10% in a month
latvia.description: Central Statistical Bureau data published on October 6th show that in September 2026 the average level of consumer prices for fuels for transport was 9.6 % higher than in August 2026.

latvia.title: President asks Kulbergs to form next Latvian government
latvia.description: On Tuesday, 6 October, President Edgars Rinkēvičs announced as expected that he would entrust the formation of the new Cabinet of Ministers to the current Prime Minister, Andris Kulbergs, whose party, the United List (AS), won a record number of seats – 41 – in the 15th Saeima elections.

latvia.title: Latvian Finance Ministry proposes austerity measures
latvia.description: Latvia's Ministry of Finance (FM) has submitted to the government on Tuesday, October 6th, a report on state budget expenditures for the fourth quarter of 2026 which calls for a dramatic cost saving effort for the rest of the year.

latvia.title: Tallinn Film Festival to showcase lots of Latvian talent
latvia.description: The 30th Tallinn Black Nights Film Festival (PÖFF) will place Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania at the heart of its 2026 edition with a special 'Focus on Baltics'. Taking place from 6–22 November 2026, the anniversary edition will bring the latest and the best of Baltic films to international audiences while creating new opportunities for the region’s filmmakers and industry professionals.

latvia.title: House sales were on the rise in Latvia last year
latvia.description: Fresh Eurostat data published on October 5th show that the number of house sales conducted in Latvia grew significantly last year.

latvia.title: Birdwatching Days spot plenty of avian creatures in Latvia
latvia.description: During the first weekend of October, birdwatchers in Latvia recorded more than 111,000 birds. Birdwatching and counting formed part of the European Autumn Birdwatching Days, or ‘EuroBirdwatch 2026’.

latvia.title: Latvia slips to late defeat against Cyprus
latvia.description: The autumn international period is coming to an end, in which Latvian footballers played their fourth match in a short period of time within the framework of the UEFA Nations League.

latvia.title: Thirteen Rīga councillors to move to parliament
latvia.description: More than a quarter of the members elected to the Saeima are current members of district and local councils and leaders of their respective parliamentary groups. Among them are several controversial figures, whose presence used to cause Rīga City Council meetings to drag on considerably. A political scientist interviewed by Latvian Radio on October 5 suggested that the commotion from Rīga City Council will now shift to the Saeima.

latvia.title: Rīga will start central heating next week
latvia.description: Riga’s largest apartment block management company, “Rīgas namu pārvaldnieks” (RNP), plans to start the heating season at the beginning of next week, the company said in a release on October 5.

latvia.title: 3 zodiaka zīmju sievietes, kurām līdz gada beigām ir īpaši liela iespēja palikt stāvoklī
latvia.description: Astroloģijā mēdz teikt, ka noteikti dzīves periodi cilvēkam atver durvis lielām pārmaiņām — attiecībās, ģimenē, mājās un arī jautājumos, kas saistīti ar bērniem. Protams, grūtniecība nav lieta, ko nosaka tikai horoskops. Tā ir veselības, attiecību, dzīves apstākļu un ļoti personisku lēmumu tēma. Tomēr astrologu skatījumā dažām zodiaka zīmēm līdz gada beigām var būt īpaši spēcīgs […]

latvia.title: Tieši rudenī virtuvē jāvāra 5 lauru lapas – pieredzējušu mājsaimnieču triks kādam būtiskam nolūkam
latvia.description: Rudenī, kad ārā kļūst vēsāks un logus vairs negribas turēt vaļā tik ilgi kā vasarā, virtuvē vakar gatavoto ēdienu smaržas mēdz uzkavēties arī nākamajā dienā. Ceptas zivis, sīpoli, kāposti vai vakariņās gatavota gaļa var atstāt aromātu, kas ne visiem ir pa prātam. Tas iesūcas drēbēs, somiņā, matos… Taču, lai atsvaidzinātu gaisu mājās, ne vienmēr vajadzīgi […]

latvia.title: Politoloģe: Stepaņenko kundzes gadījumā patiesībā viss ir ļoti nopietni
latvia.description: Pirms vēlēšanām uzmanības centrā nonākusi informācija par partiju apvienības “Suverēnā vara/Apvienība Jaunlatvieši” premjera amata kandidātes Jūlijas Stepaņenko Krievijā dzīvojošo tēvu un viņa dāvinājumiem meitai. Stepaņenko no tēva saņēmusi naudu un nekustamo īpašumu kopumā aptuveni 420 000 eiro vērtībā. Publiski izskanējusi arī informācija par tēva uzņēmuma darbību Krievijā un “pūķa zobu” ražošanu. Par to, vai šis […]

latvia.title: “Zivtiņām bezmaksas kūpinātava!” Atpūtas kuģīša izplūdes gāzes mulsina pilsētniekus
latvia.description: Rīdzinieku uzmanību piesaistījis kāds kuģītis Daugavā, no kura, pēc aculiecinieku novērotā, nāca pamatīgi dūmi. Neizpratnē par redzēto viņi ar redzēto padalījušies sociālajos tīklos, atzīmējot arī Rīgas domi un vaicājot, vai šāda kūpēšana ir normāla un vai ar kuģa tehnisko stāvokli viss ir kārtībā, vai kas tād sir pieļaujams. Komentāros gan valda samērā saprotoša attieksme, un […]

latvia.title: Īrniecei jāmaksā rēķins par cilvēku, kurš dzīvoklī nemaz nedzīvo. Vai tas ir godīgi?
latvia.description: Īrējot dzīvokli, īrniekam, protams, svarīga ir ne tikai īres maksa un atrašanās vieta. Tikpat būtiska ir saimnieka attieksme, kaimiņi, dzīvokļa tehniskais stāvoklis un tas, vai problēmu gadījumā iespējams vienoties draudzīgi par risinājumu – kā pieklājas peiaugušu cilvēku starpā, jo dažkārt pat šķietami nelieli sarežģījumi ar laiku kļūst par iemeslu arvien lielākai neapmierinātībai. Par šādu situāciju […]

latvia.title: Policija atbrauc, bet aiz sienas jau klusums – kā pierādīt regulāru kaimiņa trokšņošanu?
latvia.description: Skaļa mūzika aiz sienas, ballīte līdz vēlai naktij un tā ik dienu. Kaimiņa pacietības mērs ir pilns. Viņš zvana policijai. Taču, ierodoties likumsargiem, aiz sienas pēkšņi valda priekšzīmīgs klusums. Kā lai pierāda, ka vēl pirms brīža nakts mieru traucējusi pamatīga dārdoņa? Ar šādu situāciju LA.LV redakcijā vērsās kāds lasītājs, kurš stāsta, ka jau ilgāku laiku […]

latvia.title: Kāpēc daudziem rādās ārkārtīgi spilgti un dīvaini sapņi? Izpētīts, kas ietekmē to sižetu
latvia.description: Sapnī varam lidot pāri pilsētai, sarunāties ar cilvēku, kuru sen neesam satikuši, vai pēkšņi nonākt pavisam citā vietā, turklāt ne mirkli nebrīnīties par notiekošo. Dažreiz sapnis šķiet tik īsts, ka pēc pamošanās vēl kādu brīdi jāatgūstas. Kāpēc smadzenes naktī rada tik savādus stāstus, kāpēc vieniem sapņi ir spilgti un detalizēti, bet citiem tos grūti atcerēties? […]

latvia.title: Gribi izskatīties grezni un dārgi? Stilisti nosauc 5 krāsas, kas acumirklī padara slaidāku un piestāv ikvienai
latvia.description: Veidojot tēlu, krāsai ir liela nozīme. Ar noteiktu toņu palīdzību var pat vizuāli padarīt figūru slaidāku. Ir arī universālas apģērbu krāsas, kas piestāv ikvienai sievietei, tāpēc tās droši var iekļaut savā garderobē. Kādas apģērbu krāsas piestāv ikvienai? Melna Šī ir viena no pamata krāsām, ko uzskata par universālu un pašpietiekamu. Izvēloties pilnībā melnu tēlu, vienmēr […]

latvia.title: Dūriens Zelenskim mugurā. Eksperti spriež, vai ASV un Krievijas degvielas darījums spēs pazemināt cenas
latvia.description: ASV prezidenta Donalda Trampa vienošanās ar Krievijas diktatoru Vladimiru Putinu par vairāk nekā 300 000 tonnu dīzeļdegvielas piegādi varētu būt mēģinājums pazemināt degvielas cenas pirms ASV Kongresa vidustermiņa vēlēšanām. Taču šis solis izpelnījies asu kritiku Ukrainā, jo Krievijas ieņēmumi no energoresursu pārdošanas palīdz finansēt karu. Par to, atsaucoties uz laikrakstu “The Telegraph”, vēsta Ukrainas ziņu […]

latvia.title: Ziema Eiropā var sagādāt straujus pārsteigumus; prognozē ir kāda neparasta pazīme
latvia.description: Jaunākās prognozes par 2026./2027. gada ziemu Eiropā liecina, ka tā lielākoties varētu būt siltāka un mitrāka nekā ierasts. Lielākajā daļā kontinenta gaidāms mazāk sniega nekā parasti, bet labākas izredzes uz sniegu būs Ziemeļeiropā un kā parasti – augstkalnu apgabalos. Vienlaikus meteorologi pievērš uzmanību iespējamai neparastai polārā virpuļa vājināšanai, kas ziemas otrajā pusē varētu palielināt aukstuma […]

latvia.title: Horoskopi 11. oktobrim. Šodien centies nepārspīlēt ar jokiem, ironiju un spontāniem komentāriem
latvia.description: Auns Šodien tev var nākties pievērst īpašu uzmanību dažādām niansēm un šķietami mazsvarīgiem sīkumiem, lai pamazām izprastu notiekošo un iegūtu skaidrāku priekšstatu par situāciju. Ne viss uzreiz būs tik saprotams, tāpēc nesteidzies ar secinājumiem un pirms lēmumu pieņemšanas rūpīgi izvērtē pieejamo informāciju. Iespējams, kāds mēģinās izjokot tevi vai iesaistīt neveiklā situācijā, uzskatot to par nevainīgu […]

latvia.title: Stendzenieks par Kulberga un “Apvienotā Saraksta” potenciālo nākotni: Jo lielāka eiforija, jo smagākas paģiras
latvia.description: Pēc vēlēšanām nereti sākas diskusijas par to, vai sabiedrības vēlme pēc pārmaiņām patiešām nozīmēs arī būtiskas izmaiņas politikā. Ēriks Stendzenieks, reklāmas speciālists, Rīgas domes deputāts LPV, uzskata, ka šoreiz liela daļa vēlētāju savu izvēli izdarīja ne tik daudz par konkrētu politisko piedāvājumu, cik vilšanās dēļ līdzšinējos spēkos. TV24 raidījumā “Kārtības rullis” viņš vēlēšanu rezultātus salīdzināja […]

latvia.title: VIDEO. Ukrainas karavīri ar dronu pār Dņepru nogādā drošībā vairākus pamestus kaķus
latvia.description: Ukrainas Nacionālās gvardes 11. brigādes īpašo uzdevumu bezpilota vienības “Bolharychi” cīnītāji Krievijas okupētajā Olešku pilsētā veikuši aizkustinošu glābšanas operāciju ar nosaukumu “Tīģeri”, izglābjot sešus kaķus, kuriem draudēja bada nāve. Kaķi tika saudzīgi ievietoti speciāli pielāgotā būrī. Pēc tam būris tika piestiprināts pie smagā bumbvedēja drona, kas ar vērtīgo kravu veica vairāk nekā 10 kilometru garu […]

lithuania.title: Bóka János szerint nem kell bocsánatot kérniük, és ő sem foglalkozik üzleti ügyekkel
lithuania.description: Megkérdezték a Fidesz frakcióvezetőjét, mit gondol, mi miatt tartoznak bocsánatkéréssel.

lithuania.title: Megint egymásnak ugrik Trump és Zelenszkij a semmiből jött amerikai–orosz dízelmegállapodás miatt, de a NATO-n belül is lehet még baj ebből
lithuania.description: Egy ukrán delegáció Miamiban tárgyalt Trump képviselőivel, amikor az orosz–amerikai megállapodást bejelentette az elnök. Zelenszkij felháborodottan reagált, de amerikai fenyegetések is elhangzottak már.

lithuania.title: Bóka János szerint a Fidesznek nincs miért bocsánatot kérnie a háborús szorongást keltő kampányáért
lithuania.description: A frakcióvezető szerint ők csak „rendkívül erős vizuális képi eszközökkel” jelenítették meg az igazukat.

lithuania.title: Sweden to deploy Patriot air defence systems to Poland
lithuania.description: They will protect the NATO logistics hub in Rzeszów, which is the main conduit for aid to Ukraine.

lithuania.title: Bolid przeleciał nad Ukrainą. Nagranie
lithuania.description: Bolid, czyli bardzo jasny meteor, pojawił się na ukraińskim niebie. Zjawisko zaobserwowały kamery sieci Skytinel. Eksperci podejrzewają, że część kosmicznej skały mogła spaść na Ziemię, choć ustalenie tego może być niemożliwe.

lithuania.title: Rośnie liczba ofiar w ataku na Zaporoże. "Rosja podziękowała za zniesienie sankcji"
lithuania.description: W rosyjskim ataku na miasto Zaporoże zginęło co najmniej 15 osób, w tym troje dzieci. "Rosja podziękowała za zniesienie sankcji na eksport oleju napędowego, zrzucając kierowane bomby lotnicze na budynki mieszkalne" - skomentował Wołodymyr Zełenski.

lithuania.title: Grolich se stal senátorem hned v prvním kole
lithuania.description: Předseda KDU-ČSL a jihomoravský hejtman Jan Grolich se stal senátorem. V obvodu měl pouze dva protivníky, a to Petru Absolonovou za ANO a za Přísahu Jaroslava Fládra.

lithuania.title: Senátorem na Trutnovsku zůstává Jan Sobotka
lithuania.description: Po sečtení hlasů 70 procent volebních okrsků vede v senátním obvodu Trutnov dosavadní senátor a starosta Vrchlabí Jan Sobotka (STAN). Získal zatím téměř 58 procent podpory voličů. S velkým odstupem je za ním kandidátka hnutí ANO, lékařka Zuzana Chovancová s necelými 30 procenty. Zbývající dva kandidáti se pohybovali pod deset procent.

lithuania.title: Na Příbramsku má velkou šanci na obhajobu senátor Petr Štěpánek (STAN)
lithuania.description: Na Příbramsku do druhého kola senátních voleb postoupil stávající senátor Petr Štěpánek (STAN). Příští týden se o hlasy voličů utká s kandidátkou ANO Barborou Daňhovou.

lithuania.title: Ředitel nemocnice Tomáš Fiala obhájil senátorský post na Strakonicku
lithuania.description: Jedno kolo stačilo řediteli strakonické nemocnice Tomáši Fialovi (Naše Česko), aby obhájil senátorský post. S převahou porazil Janu Hrdinovou (KDU-ČSL) i Miroslava Ušatého (za Svob., SPD a Trikoloru) a získal téměř šedesát procent hlasů.

lithuania.title: Na Rychnovsku obhájil mandát senátor Jan Grulich
lithuania.description: Jan Grulich (TOP 09) obhájil senátorský mandát. Ve volebním obvodu Rychnov nad Kněžnou je v sobotu po šesté odpoledne sečteno téměř 80 procent hlasů a Grulich vede se ziskem 62,33 procenta. Jeho jediným protikandidátem je poslanec Jan Sadovský (ANO) z Dobrušky. Volební účast je zatím přes 45 procent.

lithuania.title: Ruský útok na Záporoží si vyžádal dvacet obětí, včetně tří dětí
lithuania.description: Ruský útok na Záporoží si vyžádal dvacet obětí, včetně tří dětí. Zraněných je osmnáct, oznámila Státní služba pro mimořádné situace (DSNS). Předtím informovala o sedmnácti mrtvých. Rusové útočili i na další ukrajinské oblasti a města, v Nikopolském okrese byl zabit chlapec. V americkém Miami jednali zástupci Spojených států, Ukrajiny, evropských zemí a členských států NATO o ukončení ruské války na Ukrajině, podle serveru Ukrajinska pravda ale rozhovory skončily předčasně.

lithuania.title: „Muslimské NATO“ v akci. Pákistán poslal Saúdům vojáky, Turci zbraně
lithuania.description: Nová vojenská aliance Saúdské Arábie, Pákistánu a Turecka přechází od rétoriky k akci. Islámábád už vyslal do Saúdské Arábie vojáky a Ankara poskytuje zemi ohrožené útoky proíránských džihádistů hútíů zbraně i zpravodajskou a logistickou podporu. Nasazení dalších sil však musí schválit turecký parlament. Otázka přímého zapojení spojenců z paktu z Mekky do bojů v Jemenu zůstává otevřená. Totální porážku hútíů experti neočekávají.

lithuania.title: Apelul lui Simion de eliberare a lui Georgescu, interpretat de Peiu: E către stat, să nu cadă iar în păcat, ca pe vremea lui Băsescu
lithuania.description: Petrișor Peiu a comentat, în cadrul interviului „În Fața Ta” difuzat sâmbătă de la ora 14:00 la Digi24, cererea lui George Simion ca fostul candidat la prezidențiale Călin Georgescu să fie eliberat din arestul preventiv. Liderul senatorilor AUR a ezitat să clarifice dacă susține acest mesaj și a spus că nu poate „angaja partidul fără acordul unui for statutar”. „Cred că nu ne-ar face bine să avem mesaje diferite”, a mai declarat Peiu.

lithuania.title: Petrișor Peiu: Guvernul Luca Niculescu, dacă va trece, va fi prezidențial. Nicușor Dan a avut un comportament greu acceptabil
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrișor Peiu, susține că desemnarea lui Luca Niculescu ca premier este „o manifestare a unei autorități personale” din partea lui Nicușor Dan, care nu a făcut o numire din rândul propunerilor oferite de partide. „Guvernul care ar rezulta, dacă va rezulta, va fi o manifestare a unei autorități prea mari a președintelui. Va fi un guvern prezidențial”, a afirmat Peiu. Interviul integral poate fi urmărit în cadrul emisiunii „În Fața Ta”, difuzată sâmbătă, de la ora 14:00, la Digi24.

lithuania.title: Rusia își intensifică producția de bombardiere Su-34. Ce spun analiștii occidentali despre avioanele folosite în Ucraina
lithuania.description: Forțele Aerospațiale ale Rusiei au primit miercuri al doilea lot de avioane de vânătoare-bombardament Su-34 produse în acest an, potrivit United Aircraft Corporation (UAC), companie care face parte din conglomeratul de stat Rostec. Aeronavele sunt cunoscute în codificarea NATO sub numele de „Fullback”, relatează Kyiv Post.

lithuania.title: Războiul care nu se vede: De ce propaganda și divizarea internă pot fi mai periculoase decât un atac militar clasic
lithuania.description: Este Europa pregătită să răspundă dacă un stat membru NATO ar fi atacat? Poate investiția în armament să devină o sursă de locuri de muncă și tehnologie? Cum câștigi un război care se poartă în mintea oamenilor? Ne răspunde la întrebări Marie-Agnes Starck Zimmerman, preşedintele Comisiei pentru Securitate și Apărare din Parlamentul European.

lithuania.title: Exercițiile militare nucleare NATO care îl enervează pe Putin. Alianța încearcă să calmeze tensiunile cu Rusia
lithuania.description: NATO încearcă să asigure Rusia că viitorul exerciţiu nuclear din Italia nu reprezintă un motiv de îngrijorare, în contextul tensiunilor ridicate dintre alianţă şi Moscova, scrie Politico.

lithuania.title: Un avion militar algerian a zburat prin spațiul aerian al NATO cu destinația Moscova. Ce țări a survolat
lithuania.description: Un avion militar algerian a zburat prin spațiul aerian european și NATO cu destinația Moscova, pe 6 octombrie. Polonia declară că a autorizat zborul, care nu este primul de acest fel, pe baza informațiilor furnizate de Algeria. Încărcătura și misiunea precisă a aeronavei nu au fost făcute publice, relatează Business Insider Africa.

lithuania.title: Ce să mănânci pentru un colon sănătos. Alimentele recomandate de specialiști și obiceiurile care pot afecta intestinul
lithuania.description: Alimentația, hidratarea și stilul de viață influențează funcționarea colonului și echilibrul microbiomului intestinal. Ce alegeri alimentare și obiceiuri zilnice susțin sănătatea digestivă, dar și care sunt simptomele ce necesită o evaluare medicală.

lithuania.title: Ascensiunea extremei drepte amenință eforturile Europei de reînarmare. Sprijinul pentru Ucraina, tot mai contestat
lithuania.description: Ascensiunea partidelor de extremă dreaptă în Europa stârnește îngrijorări în NATO, pe fondul riscului ca acestea să reducă sprijinul public pentru creșterea bugetelor de apărare și pentru ajutorul militar acordat Ucrainei. În Franța, Italia, Germania, Polonia, România și alte state europene, formațiunile de dreapta radicală folosesc nemulțumirile legate de costul vieții pentru a contesta cheltuielile militare și proiectele comune de apărare ale Uniunii Europene, potrivit Politico.

lithuania.title: Alertă de securitate la o bază militară britanică folosită de SUA și NATO. Doi cetățeni letoni au fost arestați
lithuania.description: Doi cetățeni letoni au fost arestați după ce au fost descoperiți în incinta unei baze militare britanice care găzduiește centre de informații ale SUA și NATO. Cei doi ar fi pătruns în baza RAF Molesworth printr-o breșă în gardul împrejmuitor, iar incidentul este investigat de poliția antiteroristă, relatează BBC.

lithuania.title: „Dacă Grindeanu și-ar fi dorit cu adevărat mandatul, președintele i l-ar fi dat”. De ce crede Peiu că există un binom Nicușor Dan – PSD
lithuania.description: Petrișor Peiu, liderul senatorilor AUR, a estimat, la Digi24, că guvernul lui Luca Niculescu are șanse să fie învestit, cu sprijinul PSD. Peiu crede că Sorin Grindeanu nu și-a dorit cu adevărat mandatul de prim-ministru și că există „un fel de binom Nicușor Dan – PSD”, care-l pune la adăpost pe președinte de o eventuală …

lithuania.title: Feature: Spanish jets leave Ämari — but the Baltic mission goes on
lithuania.description: NATO's Baltic air mission is now over 20 years old and was recently upgraded to a defense posture — making it high time to visit Ämari Air Base to catch up on developments.

lithuania.title: NATO chief Mark Rutte to visit Estonia next week
lithuania.description: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte is due to visit Estonia next week, meeting the country's leaders and visiting Ämari Air Base and Tallinn University of Technology.

lithuania.title: Zelenskõi: Trumpi diislitehing on sünnipäevakingitus Putinile
lithuania.description: Ukraina president seostas Venemaa laupäevase raketirünnaku pealinnale USA ja Venemaa diislikokkuleppega ning nimetas seda Trumpi sünnipäevakingiks Putinile.

lithuania.title: Tallinn Film Festival to showcase lots of Latvian talent
lithuania.description: The 30th Tallinn Black Nights Film Festival (PÖFF) will place Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania at the heart of its 2026 edition with a special 'Focus on Baltics'. Taking place from 6–22 November 2026, the anniversary edition will bring the latest and the best of Baltic films to international audiences while creating new opportunities for the region’s filmmakers and industry professionals.

lithuania.description: ASV prezidenta Donalda Trampa vienošanās ar Krievijas diktatoru Vladimiru Putinu par vairāk nekā 300 000 tonnu dīzeļdegvielas piegādi varētu būt mēģinājums pazemināt degvielas cenas pirms ASV Kongresa vidustermiņa vēlēšanām. lithuania.title: VIDEO. Ukrainas karavīri ar dronu pār Dņepru nogādā drošībā vairākus pamestus kaķus
lithuania.description: Ukrainas Nacionālās gvardes 11. brigādes īpašo uzdevumu bezpilota vienības “Bolharychi” cīnītāji Krievijas okupētajā Olešku pilsētā veikuši aizkustinošu glābšanas operāciju ar nosaukumu “Tīģeri”, izglābjot sešus kaķus, kuriem draudēja bada nāve. lithuania.description: Krievija pastiprina apšaudes un bombardēšanu Kramatorskā un Slovjanskā – divās lielākajās Ukrainas kontrolētajās pilsētās Doneckas apgabalā. lithuania.description: ASV prezidenta Donalda Trampa ierastie sūtņi sarunām ar Krieviju, Stīvs Vitkofs un Džereds Kušners< sarunās ar Ukrainas delegāciju piedraudējuši ar kādu ļoti būtisku lietu. lithuania.title: Pusaudzis sūdzas par izaugumu virs plakstiņa; pat ārsti neticēja savām acīm – tas bija zobs
lithuania.description: Kādam 16 gadus vecam puisim Indijā vairākus mēnešus stāvēja nesāpīgs pietūkums virs kreisās acs. Taču vēlāk no ādas sāka izspiesties divi asi, balti veidojumi. Tas, ko ārsti atklāja izmeklējumā, izrādījās ārkārtīgi rets anatomisks gadījums – izaugumi bija daļa no pilnībā izveidojušās zoba struktūras. lithuania.title: Volodymyro Zelenskio patarėjas: Ukrainos delegacija po derybų Majamyje grįžta namo
lithuania.description: Ukrainos pareigūnų delegacija, kuri buvo atvykusi į Majamį derybų dėl Rusijos karo Ukrainoje užbaigimo, grįžta namo, šeštadienį pranešė Ukrainos prezidento Volodymyro Zelenskio patarėjas.

lithuania.title: Lenkijoje – trečias per mažiau nei savaitę išpuolis mokykloje
lithuania.description: Lenkijoje šeštadienį įvyko trečias per mažiau nei savaitę išpuolis mokykloje: 21-erių moteris vienoje švietimo įstaigoje sostinėje Varšuvoje sužeidė tris žmones, pranešė policija.

lithuania.title: Rusija stiprina karo eskalaciją: ES pripažįsta, kad Ukrainai gali nebeužtekti milijardinės paramos
lithuania.description: Spartėjanti Rusijos vykdoma karo eskalacija verčia abejoti daugybės Europos Sąjungos (ES) paramos Ukrainai programų pakankamumu. Diplomatai pripažįsta, kad lyderiams teliko laiko klausimas, kada jie imsis šio prieštaringai vertinamo klausimo, rašo „Euronews“.

lithuania.title: Jemeno pajėgos teigia stumiančios atgal husių sukilėlius
lithuania.description: Vyriausybei pradėjus operaciją prarastoms teritorijoms atkovoti, Jemeno pajėgos stumiasi į priekį prieš husius Bab al Mandebo sąsiaurio apylinkėse, tačiau šio vandens kelio kontrolės dar neužsitikrino, naujienų agentūrai AFP šeštadienį pranešė Jemeno kariniai šaltiniai.

lithuania.title: Mūšio laukas dėl populiaraus Kauno traukos objekto likimo – sunaikinimą laikinai sustabdė tik teismas
lithuania.description: Per daugiau nei dešimtmetį nemokamu muziejumi po atviru dangumi, instagramiškiausiu Kauno kiemeliu vadinama „Kiemo galerija“ tapo tikru turistų ir smalsuolių traukos centru. Tačiau daliai sieninių kūrinių staiga iškilo grėsmė – pradėjus daugiabučio remonto darbus, užsibrėžta piešinius sunaikinti. Namo gyventojai nesileidžia į jokias kalbas, nevertina šios lankytinos vietos, tad į konfliktą teko įsitraukti teismui.

lithuania.title: Liudininkai: iš Rijado oro uosto evakuojami žmonės
lithuania.description: Iš Rijado tarptautinio oro uosto šeštadienį evakuojami žmonės, naujienų agentūrai AFP pranešė trys liudininkai.

lithuania.title: ES: sankcijų dyzelinui panaikinimas suteikia Rusijai pajamų karui
lithuania.description: JAV prezidentui Donaldui Trumpui (Donaldui Trampui) paskelbus apie susitarimą su Maskva dėl dyzelino tiekimo, Europos Sąjungos (ES) diplomatijos vadovė Kaja Kallas (Kaja Kalas) šeštadienį pareiškė, kad sankcijų šiam Rusijos kurui panaikinimas padeda palaikyti Kremliaus karą prieš Ukrainą.

lithuania.title: Revolverio šūvis Kaišiadorių parduotuvėje priminė svarbias taisykles: kaip civiliai gali nešiotis ginklus?
lithuania.description: Kaišiadorių parduotuvėje nutikęs incidentas, kai iš vyro rankinės iškritęs teisėtai laikomas revolveris „Nagan“ iššovė ir sužalojo šalia stovėjusią jo sutuoktinę, iškėlė ir platesnį klausimą – kaip civiliai Lietuvoje apskritai gali laikyti, nešiotis bei gabenti ginklus ir kokių taisyklių privalo laikytis jų savininkai.

lithuania.title: Kremlius: Vladimiras Putinas Donaldui Trumpui perdavė Irano poziciją dėl taikos susitarimo
lithuania.description: Rusijos prezidentas Vladimiras Putinas šeštadienį JAV prezidentui Donaldui Trumpui (Donaldui Trampui) perdavė Irano poziciją dėl galimo taikos susitarimo Artimuosiuose Rytuose, pranešė Kremlius.

lithuania.title: Prieš didelį protestą Indijoje sulaikytas „tarakonų“ jaunimo judėjimo lyderis
lithuania.description: Prieš planuotą didelį protestą prieš Rinkimų komisiją Indijos policija šeštadienį sulaikė satyrinio internetinio „tarakonų“ judėjimo „Cockroach Janta Party“ (CJP) vadovą, pranešė partija.

lithuania.title: Ministerija negavo daugiau informacijos apie Nepale vykusių potvynių metu dingusią lietuvę
lithuania.description: Užsienio reikalų ministerija neturi naujos informacijos apie rugpjūčio pabaigoje Nepale per potvynius dingusią Lietuvos pilietę.
